localContext: Commercial garage doors in Berwyn face specific challenges. Many businesses occupy buildings built in the 1920s or earlier. These structures often feature original or very old garage door hardware. The constant cycle of Chicago weather, from freezing winters to humid summers, stresses metal components. Springs fatigue, rollers seize, and tracks bend. This is common for older rolling steel curtains and loading dock doors, especially in areas like the Cermak Road corridor or near the Proksa Park area. Original bungalow garages in Berwyn, though residential, show how old infrastructure struggles with modern demands. Commercial doors have similar issues. They demand smooth, full-width travel to handle daily operations. Worn parts cannot deliver this reliability.
